capability.summary: Infer a JSON Schema from one JSON file
capability.description: Loads one JSON document from disk, adds that document as a single GenSON sample, and returns the inferred schema produced by SchemaBuilder.
capability.problem_space: Initial JSON Schema inference from one representative JSON value stored in a file.

constraint.io_signature: Input: path to one JSON file; output: JSON success payload containing the inferred schema object under schema.
accepted_inputs: a readable filesystem path containing one valid JSON object, array, scalar, or null value
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.genson_schema", and schema as the JSON Schema object returned by GenSON's SchemaBuilder. A caught file-read, JSON-decoding, or schema-inference exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.genson_schema", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: infers from exactly one loaded JSON document and does not merge multiple sample files or records through repeated add_object calls
inference reflects observed values and cannot recover undocumented semantic constraints such as formats, ranges, or business rules
does not validate the sample against an existing schema
missing files, unreadable content, and invalid JSON are returned through the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: GenSON-inferred JSON Schema object derived from the single JSON document.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: infer JSON Schema from a JSON file
create a draft schema from one JSON sample
negative_intents: validate JSON against an existing schema
combine multiple sample files into one inferred schema
author semantic validation rules not present in sample data

output_contract.description: GenSON-inferred JSON Schema object derived from the single JSON document.
